^xE0C080Gemling Legionnaire / Twister: imported-character's Twister

^xE0C080At a glance

Twister sends spinning blades through packs from range, carried by the character's own spear and buckler. This guide is the improved character's endgame only: level with any Mercenary build.

- Pros: one button from range; the character's own gear, its rares written as the stats to buy.
- Cons: cold resistance sits low, and the Arbiter's slam one-shots it.
- Difficulty: easy.

^xE0C080Your PoB file

Import this code in PoB2 (Import/Export Build, then Import from code):

The file is imported-character better.xml. Its one loadout: Endgame (L90) {b}. Engine: PoB2 v0.23.1 (patch 0.5.4). Made offline, so no prices were checked.

^xE0C080Switching over

Level with any Mercenary build, and switch to this one at level 90, gear from level 90, because Spear Throw, Virtuous Barrier and Purity of Ice are gem level 20. Take the Gemling Legionnaire ascendancy in the order the loadout lists. The campaign rewards are the character's own, as its file sets them.

Respeccing from a levelling build: the PoB file holds the rung's whole tree; refund what it doesn't use. The gold cost isn't computed.

^xE0C080Survival by stage

The budget label is the Arbiter of Divinity's verdict.

- Budget (L90): one-shot by the Arbiter's physical hit (it survives 2% of them). Resistances 60/29/49/0% at −60%. Max hit 1,582 physical against about 402, and at least 1,582 elemental or chaos against about 97. Twister about 38 DPS against map monsters, about 38 against resisting rares, about 37 against a Pinnacle boss. Effective HP about 2,760.

^xE0C080Priorities

My support order: Salvo, then Projectile Acceleration III. Short on spirit? See the switch lines under the gems.

^xE0C080Endgame: budget

This rung is the improved character. Buy its rares by these stats: a rare Two-Stone Ring with maximum life and fire resistance; a rare Hunting Spear with added physical damage, attack speed and accuracy.

- Gems: Twister (level 5, quality 20) with Salvo and Projectile Acceleration III; Herald of Ice and Combat Frenzy.
- Virtuous Barrier: switch it on as needed.
- Trinity: switch it on as needed; switch Herald of Ice and Combat Frenzy off for it.
- Blasphemy: switch it on as needed; switch Herald of Ice and Combat Frenzy off for it.
- Wind Dancer: switch it on as needed.
- Raise the Shrine Sceptre to quality 20 with Arcanist's Etchers: Purity of Ice takes its quality.

^xE0C080Checks

- Budget: unknown, aiming at about 5 a slot.
  Prices are unavailable (offline run), so this rung's total isn't known.
- The Arbiter of Divinity: one-shot by its physical hit, at 2.20 of your max hit; it survives 2% of them.
- Clear speed: slow, a rough estimate from Twister's area. Movement speed: +26%.

^xE0C080How to play it

Twister takes the packs from range and the rares with it: keep moving and recast.

^xE0C080What PoB can't show

The figures use the character's own configuration, as its file sets it. Wind Dancer counts two copies, as the file sets it.

^xE0C080Known issues

None.

^xE0C080FAQ

- Why no levelling section? Any Mercenary build levels you to 90; this guide starts there.
